results.title: Paris Hilton drops major hint about new project with BFF Nicole Richie
results.description: Paris Hilton drops major hint about new project with BFF Nicole RichieParis Hilton has confirmed that she and her BFF Nicole Richie are working on a "new project.""Nicole and I are talking now and making plans for another new project soon, so I cannot wait," the 45-year-old actress told Us Weekly...
